title: Saving the General Matrix confirms and counts its categories
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Note how many categories Settings › Categories shows on the General Matrix, Uncategorized included (for example 9).
  • Note the General Matrix's Default value in its first range, to put it back at the end.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click the General Matrix's name.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Type a new value in Default's first range.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Click Save in the dialog.
  7. Click Edit.
  8. Type the noted value in Default's first range.
  9. Click Save.
  10. Click Save in the dialog.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The General Matrix is listed.

Step 2:

  • The General Matrix page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • The bar counts 1 change.

Step 5:

  • A dialog titled "Save the General Matrix?" opens with Cancel and Save, not Change All.
  • It reads "This changes prices for 9 categories without a matrix of their own." (the noted 9, Uncategorized included: 9 = 9).

Step 6:

  • The grid saves and the saved message shows.

Step 7:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 8:

  • The bar counts 1 change.

Step 9:

  • The same confirmation opens.

Step 10:

  • The General Matrix is back to the noted value.
